name: Agents Deep Research
description: Deep-research assistant built on the OpenAI Agents SDK, with iterative and deep modes for long reports.
whatItDoes: Researches a topic in depth and writes a report, either through a single iterative researcher or a deeper mode that plans sections and researches them separately. It is for developers who want an Agents SDK-based research pipeline.
howItWorks: Agents identify knowledge gaps, select tools such as web search and site crawling, and loop until a time or iteration limit is hit; the deep mode runs several of these in parallel under a planner. It is available as a pip package with a command-line entry point.
run: deep-researcher --mode deep --query "Provide a comprehensive overview of quantum computing" --max-iterations 3 --max-time 10 --verbose
models: OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, DeepSeek, Perplexity, OpenRouter, Hugging Face, local models
